purpose: Post-hoc diagnostic follow-up for v1 assessment-polarity and scope-referent ambiguity; not a held-out benchmark or replacement for original scores.
provenance: Derived from seven newly authored synthetic v1 fixtures after inspecting first-repeat outputs. Retains original evidence, schemas, source IDs, and technical literals. No HumanWill research or held-out data used.
execution_policy: No tools are executed. No target requests, browsing, commands, filesystem mutations, or report saves are permitted. Model calls are performed only by the separately budgeted evaluation runner.
changes: Name one positive proposition and define assessment against that proposition, including missing/contrary evidence as inconclusive.
Name offline review as both the allowed and assessed activity, eliminating in_scope versus not_applicable referent ambiguity.
Retain the native v1 response schema and original raw evidence; use new suffixed IDs to separate all follow-up requests/results.
limitations: Selected after observing v1 outputs, so diagnostic evidence only; retain and report v1 scores separately.
All seven scope labels are intentionally in_scope; this follow-up does not measure out-of-scope discrimination.
No target calls, tool execution, or task performance validation.
